title: PlayerMessage
description: A message from an inhabitant (or the world) to the player, kept in the mailbox with history (B6 R11). Exactly one of text and text_key is set: AI-generated messages carry text in the language they were written in, system messages carry a translation key. The core checks this rule and owns status and urgency.

message_id.description: Mailbox id assigned by the core.

inhabitant_id.description: Sender; null for messages of the world itself.

kind.description: Message kind id from content/player/message_kinds.json (request, hint, thought, thanks, complaint, knock).

text.description: AI-generated text; null for system messages.

text_key.description: Translation key for system messages; null for AI-generated text.

urgency.description: 0 = calm; rises while unacknowledged up to the limit of the message kind. Shown by order and a warm tint, never by blinking or sound (B2466).

repeats.description: How often the message was repeated while unacknowledged.

acknowledged_tick.description: Tick the player acknowledged it; null while open.
